Location: Pune
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) - Freshly Qualified
Experience: CA Freshers with Articleship experience in Internal Audit, Risk Advisory, IFC/SOX, Process Reviews, and Compliance Audits.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

- Execute internal audit assignments across various industries under the guidance of senior team members.
- Assist in identifying, assessing, and monitoring business risks and internal controls.
- Support process reviews and recommend improvements to enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.
- Participate in risk assessments, internal control reviews, and compliance audits.
- Assist in documentation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Risk Control Matrices (RCMs), and audit reports.
- Support clients in evaluating compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
- Assist in testing internal controls and contributing to Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and SOX engagements.
- Prepare audit working papers, observations, recommendations, and management reports.
- Build professional relationships with client stakeholders and work effectively within engagement teams.
- Deliver assigned tasks within agreed timelines and quality standards.
- Participate in business development initiatives, research activities, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Preferred Industry Exposure During Articleship

Candidates with exposure to one or more of the following sectors will be preferred:

- Manufacturing
- Automotive
- Pharmaceuticals
- Infrastructure
- Real Estate
- Construction & Contracting
- Oil & Gas
- Industrial Projects

- Understanding of Internal Audit, Risk Management, and Internal Controls.
- Basic knowledge of IFC and SOX frameworks.
- Familiarity with accounting standards and provisions of the Companies Act, 2013.
- Knowledge of risk assessment methodologies and process documentation.
- Exposure to ERP systems such as SAP will be an added advantage.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

Soft Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Good verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to independently manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines.
- Professional attitude and strong attention to detail.
- Willingness to learn and work in a client-facing environment.
- Open to travel across India and potentially to the Middle East based on project requirements.

Why Join Protiviti?

- Chance to work with leading organizations across multiple industries.
- Exposure to Internal Audit, Risk Advisory, IFC/SOX, Process Transformation, and Compliance engagements.
- Structured learning environment with strong mentorship and career growth opportunities.
- Dynamic and collaborative work culture with global exposure.

Immediate joiners and candidates actively exploring opportunities are encouraged to apply.}

Subject Line: CA Fresher Pune

Company Description B K Kothari & Associates LLP is a professional services firm specializing in audit, accounts, taxation, and business support services. The firm is known for delivering innovative, technically sound solutions that are practical and easy to implement. With a strong focus on client individuality, the team provides personalized services while maintaining high professional standards and strong ethical practices. The firm combines dedicated staff and specialized consultants to offer comprehensive guidance in a competitive, governance-focused business environment. • Pursuing or completed CA articleship eligibility (or equivalent professional training requirement); commerce or finance-related academic background preferred.
• High level of integrity, willingness to learn, and openness to feedback and continuous professional development.

Job Title: Commercial FP&A Analyst Coatings

Location: Pune, India

Shift: Night Shift

Experience: 5 - 10 years

Role Purpose

The Commercial FP&A Analyst will support the Commercial Finance function by providing financial analysis and business insights across P&L, budgeting, forecasting, margin management, OPEX, CAPEX and working capital. The role involves partnering with Commercial Navigators, Sales teams and Global FP&A stakeholders to analyse financial performance, identify trends, explain variances and support business decision-making. The candidate will also drive reporting automation, process standardisation and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and manage P&L, Working Capital, Commercial CAPEX and Balance Sheet provisions, including budgeting, rolling forecasts, month-end closing and financial analysis.

• Partner with business stakeholders to prepare budgets, forecasts, management reports and presentations.

• Support month-end closing activities, including accrual reviews, one-off items, flash P&L commentary and closing presentations.

• Conduct margin and profitability analysis at customer, product and country levels, including Price-Volume-Mix (PVM) analysis.

• Analyse COGS, OPEX, Sales and Distribution expenses, CAPEX and working capital to identify variances and improvement opportunities.

• Collaborate with Commercial Navigators, Sales teams, Global BU FP&A and Finance teams to provide insights and recommendations.

• Prepare standard and ad hoc financial reports, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

• Drive reporting automation, process standardisation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Requirements

• CA / ICWA (maximum 3 attempts) or MBA from a Top 20 B-school.

• 5 - 10 years of experience in FP&A, Commercial Finance or Financial Analysis.

• Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, P&L management and financial reporting.

• Good understanding of margin analysis, profitability, Price-Volume-Mix (PVM), COGS, OPEX, CAPEX and working capital.

• Experience in month-end closing, variance analysis and management reporting.

• Strong knowledge of HFM, ERP systems (preferably SAP) and Business Intelligence tools.

• Advanced Excel skills and experience in financial modelling and report automation.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to interpret complex financial data and present meaningful business insights.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Shift Requirement

• This position is based in Pune and requires working in a night shift.

• Candidates must be comfortable coordinating with global Finance and business stakeholders across different time zones.

• Ability to independently manage deliverables and ensure accurate and timely reporting during night-shift operations is essential.

Position Summary
The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager is responsible for leading the Company’s budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and business analysis activities. This role serves as a strategic business partner to executive leadership and operational stakeholders by delivering timely financial insights, supporting critical business decisions, and driving financial performance across the organization.
The FP&A Manager will develop financial plans, enhance reporting capabilities, and support the Company’s long-term strategic objectives. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong analytical judgment, commercial acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
Financial Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting
• Lead the annual budgeting process, monthly/quarterly rolling forecasts, and long-range financial planning initiatives.

• Develop, maintain, and enhance financial models supporting revenue, operating expenses, headcount, capital expenditures, cash flow, and profitability projections.

• Monitor financial performance against last year, budget and forecast, identifying key trends, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.

• Conduct scenario planning and sensitivity analyses to support strategic decision-making and resource allocation.

• Coordinate planning activities across business functions to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and planning assumptions.

Financial Reporting and Analysis
• Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual management reporting packages.

• Analyze financial and operational results and provide clear explanations of key business drivers and variances.

• Develop, monitor, and continuously improve key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.

• Present financial results, outlooks, and recommendations to executive and senior leadership.

• Business Partnership and Strategic Support

• Partner with departmental leaders to evaluate business initiatives, investments, and operating strategies.

• Provide decision support related to hiring plans, capital investments, pricing, and expense management.

• Perform profitability, margin, customer, product, and cost analyses to improve financial performance.

Process Improvement and Financial Systems
• Identify and implement improvements to budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analytical processes.

• Drive automation and standardization initiatives that enhance efficiency, scalability, and data integrity.

• Collaborate with Accounting, IT, and operational teams to improve financial data quality and reporting capabilities.

• Maintain clear documentation of planning processes, methodologies, assumptions, and relevant controls.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner closely with Accounting to ensure consistency between actual results, forecasts, and financial reporting.

• Support month-end and quarter-end review processes through variance analysis and management reporting.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders by translating financial data into actionable recommendations.

• Lead or participate in special projects and ad hoc financial analyses requested by senior management

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field required.

• MBA, CA, CMA, or other relevant professional certification preferred.

• Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or a related field.

• Demonstrated experience managing budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and management reporting processes.

• Experience partnering with business leaders and presenting financial information to senior management.

• Prior experience in SaaS, technology, fintech, financial services, or another high-growth environment preferred.

Technical Competencies
• Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario-analysis skills.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, cash flow analysis, unit economics, and performance management.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial data analysis.

• Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or comparable platforms.

• Experience with planning and business intelligence tools such as Anaplan, Workday Adaptive Planning, Pigment, Vena, OneStream, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable solutions.

• Strong data visualization, reporting, and presentation capabilities.

Key Performance Indicators
• Performance may be evaluated using the following measures, as applicable to the organization:

• Forecast accuracy and reliability.

• Budget adherence and effectiveness of variance management.

• Timeliness, accuracy, and quality of management reporting.

• Effectiveness of business partnership and decision support.

• Process efficiency improvements, standardization, and automation achievements.

• Quality of analysis supporting strategic initiatives.

• Contribution to profitability, cost optimization, cash management, and organizational growth.

Leadership Expectations
• Demonstrate ownership and accountability for financial planning and reporting activities.

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making.

• Promote collaboration, transparency, integrity, and operational excellence across the organization.

Job Title: Head – Finance & Accounts (Chartered Accountant)

Location: Pune – MH

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: 10–15 years

About the Company

DDE ULTRA is a pioneering provider of ultra-high purity process utility systems serving the semiconductor, PV Solar and other high-tech industries. We specialize in designing, manufacturing and installing complex utility systems and turnkey solutions.

We are seeking an Experienced Chartered Accountant (CA) to independently lead the complete Finance & Accounts function, ensuring financial control, compliance, accurate reporting, effective cost management and sound financial decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
• Take end-to-end ownership of accounting, finance operations, monthly and annual book closures, and finalization of accounts.
• Prepare and review financial statements, cash-flow reports, MIS and management dashboards, present key financial insights to senior management.
• Lead annual budgeting, periodic budget forecasting and financial planning across departments and projects.
• Conduct budget-versus-actual variance analysis, investigate deviations and recommend corrective actions.
• Manage cost control and optimization, including project costs, material, manpower, overheads and operating expenses; monitor cost overruns and profitability.
• Oversee cash flow, working capital, fund planning, receivables, payables, banking relationships and facilities such as BGs and LCs, wherever applicable.
• Manage direct and indirect taxation, including GST, TDS and income tax, ensuring timely filings, reconciliations and resolution of notices.
• Lead statutory, internal and tax audits; coordinate with auditors and consultants and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
• Oversee project accounting, project-wise costing, billing, revenue recognition, work-in-progress, retention and profitability reporting.
• Establish and strengthen financial policies, internal controls, approval mechanisms, accounting procedures and compliance calendars.
• Lead and guide the Accounts & Finance team, review deliverables and ensure timely and accurate completion of activities.
• Coordinate with projects, procurement, stores, HR, sales and other teams on budgets, costs, collections, payments and financial matters.

Technical Skills
• Strong knowledge of accounting standards, financial reporting, finalization of accounts and taxation.
• Expertise in budgeting, forecasting, budget-versus-actual variance analysis and cost management.
• Strong understanding of cash flow, treasury, working capital, project costing and profitability analysis.
• Hands-on experience in GST, TDS, income tax, statutory compliance and audit management.
• Knowledge of internal financial controls, risk management and financial process improvement.
• Proficiency in ERP / SAP / Tally and advanced MS Excel; ability to prepare MIS and management reports.

If you are GREAT in the above, not just good, then we need you in our Team.

Qualifications & Skills
• Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
• 10–15 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably in engineering, manufacturing, EPC or project-based organizations.
• Demonstrated ability to independently manage the complete finance function, including accounting, taxation, audits, banking and statutory compliance.
• Proven experience in annual budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, cost control and project profitability management.
• Experience in financial reporting, cash-flow and working-capital management, internal controls and team leadership.
• Strong analytical, decision-making, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with high integrity and accountability.

Preferred Industry Background
• Engineering, manufacturing and industrial organizations.
• Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) companies.
• Project-based engineering, infrastructure and turnkey solution providers.
• Semiconductor, PV Solar, process engineering and industrial utility industries.

Additional Information
• This is a senior-level role with independent ownership of the organization's Finance & Accounts function.
• The candidate must combine hands-on financial management with leadership-level planning, reporting and decision support.
• Experience in managing finance for a growing engineering, manufacturing or EPC business will be an advantage.

Job Description

Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager – India Lead, CTF & BSRA

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager to join our Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) & Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) team within Finance. This role is located in Pune, India.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

• Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.
• Plan & forecast: Own the end-to-end Balance Sheet and Net Interest Income (NII) plan and forecast process (plan rounds, rest-of-year and multi-year outlooks) for supported Lines of Business, ensuring a consistent methodology and timely submission into planning systems.
• Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.
• NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.
• Subject-matter expertise: Provide leadership on Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), liquidity metrics (LCR and liquidity stress testing), interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing balance dynamics, and assess the impact of central bank rate changes, client flows and product/currency mix on deposits and NII.
• Reporting & analytics: Oversee daily, weekly, month-end and quarterly reporting – including month-to-date NII estimates, earnings support, management memos and client-, LOB- and firm-level analytics such as deposit pricing cohorts, client movers and beta analysis.
• Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.
• Scope expansion: Identify and lead the transition of new LOBs, platforms and processes into the India hub, partnering with Finance Data Strategy, Technology and other Centers of Excellence on firm-wide initiatives.
• Transformation & AI: Drive process simplification, report rationalization and adoption of Power BI, self-serve dashboards, automation and AI agents, tracking measurable efficiency gains aligned to Finance objectives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

• Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.
• Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.
• Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.
• Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.
• Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.
• People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at:

BNY Newsroom

BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

• America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
• World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

ABOUT CENCORA & ABFINCO

Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen) is a Fortune 10 global pharmaceutical distribution and solutions company operating in more than 65 countries. ABFinco is Cencora’s international in-house bank, providing central cash pooling, foreign exchange and intercompany funding services to international businesses including Alliance Healthcare, World Courier and PharmaLex. ABFinco manages exposures in more than 10 active currencies.

ROLE PURPOSE

The Senior Treasury Accountant will deliver accurate, timely and well-controlled accounting for ABFinco’s foreign exchange, intercompany lending and cash activities. The role owns treasury accounting from transaction capture in Kyriba through posting and reconciliation in SAP, leads the monthly close, and provides quality review and technical support to Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts. Reporting to the Treasury Accounting Lead, the role will also strengthen controls, reporting and processes as the in-house treasury accounting function develops.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Treasury Accounting and Close

· Own accounting for FX, hedging, cash and intercompany treasury transactions in Kyriba and SAP.

· Review treasury entries, valuations and interest accruals.

· Lead the monthly close and deliver accurate management accounts and treasury reporting between workday 1 and workday 3.

· Reconcile Kyriba to SAP, resolve differences and maintain complete supporting documentation.

· Support hedge-accounting calculations, statutory reporting, Group consolidation and internal and external audits.

Intercompany Loans and Cash

· Oversee accounting and reconciliation for intercompany loans, cash pools and Group funding balances across 102 entities.

· Review loan interest, reference rates and margins against agreements and transfer-pricing requirements.

· Prepare and review loan, cash and bank reconciliation reports.

Controls and Systems

· Operate treasury-accounting controls, maintain audit evidence and support control testing.

· Maintain treasury-system master data and support Kyriba-to-SAP interfaces, reporting and process improvements.

· Support regulatory reporting and ensure transactions comply with internal policies and segregation-of-duties requirements.

Team and Stakeholder Support

· Act as the subject matter expert and escalation point for Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts.

· Work with Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, IT, banking partners and international finance teams to resolve issues and support change.
